lines.text: The concept is looked up as a Bar (Planning Code § 102).
Zoning district NCT-MISSION: a Bar on the first story is a conditional use (Planning Code § 754, in force from 2024-01-14 (Ord. 249-23, File No. 230701)).

NCT-MISSION: the table caps the eating and drinking uses (Restaurants, Limited Restaurants and Bars) in the district at 179, and a new one is not permitted if it would take the total above that (Table 754 Note 7, in force from 2024-01-14 (Ord. 249-23, File No. 230701)). The records do not show how many there are.
No story is stated, so the first story was read.

Mission Alcoholic Beverage Special Use District: A new or relocated Bar is considered under the underlying zoning, but always as a Conditional Use. Here: a Bar is a conditional use (Planning Code § 249.60(b)(2)(C), in force since before 2022-01-01).

Mission Alcoholic Beverage Special Use District: A new Bar must use a liquor licence transferred from another Bar located inside the district. This is a requirement, not a control (Planning Code § 249.60(b)(2)(C), in force since before 2022-01-01).

Mission Alcoholic Beverage Special Use District: The § 202.2 operating conditions apply to every liquor establishment in the district; new, relocated or expanded ones, and any with a licence referred to Planning by ABC, must also provide outside lighting, keep window signage to 33% and keep 50% clear glazing on street-facing facades. This is a requirement, not a control (Planning Code § 249.60(d), in force since before 2022-01-01).

Mission Alcoholic Beverage Special Use District: No new establishment with an ABC Type 75 licence (brewpub) may open in the subsection (f) sub-area. The licence types this rule reaches (Type 75) are not ones the use proposed may hold, so it was not applied (Planning Code § 249.60(f)(2), in force since before 2022-01-01).
Zoning district NCT-MISSION has no hours of operation control on file (Planning Code § 754, in force since before 2022-01-01), so this trigger does not apply.
No active ABC licence of a type the rules read (Types 41, 42, 47, 48, 61, 75) is on file at 200 Capp St, so the records do not show what the space is used as now.
The records do not show what the space is used as, and the description does not say what it was last used as, so whether the proposed use (Bar) is a change of use is not established.
